title: The theft report is a silent alarm
body_md: A theft report is received if the vehicle moves further from its original location than the distance stated by the source while the connected alarm system is activated. It is a **silent** alarm: neither the indicators nor the siren are activated. According to the source, both can be switched on afterwards by text message.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Theft report”
prev_context: Before this stands the status report.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 19: equivalent in substance, including the silent alarm. Both versions name the same distance; it is not reproduced because three different values are on record across the generations (DSC-078) and BLK-007 applies. The English cross-reference is set twice (DSC-089) and leads nowhere in either version (DSC-041).
